column1: # RTD2142 stock firmware (17eea728...d802): names for code and XDATA, for Ghidra.
# Apply with research/ghidra/RenameSymbols.java; rtd2142_map.REGISTERS is added on top.
# Columns: bank (0-7, or * for every bank), space (CODE or EXTMEM), address (hex), name, note.
# A trailing "_q" in a name marks a role inferred from one use site and not yet confirmed.

column5: MOV DPTR,#target; LJMP here: call target in bank 0
writes 0 to XDATA FFFF (bank register), RET into target
Keil C51 ?C?CCASE: switch on A, table of (hi,lo,value) after the LCALL

column1: # --- 0x35 debug interface (I2C slave over DP AUX; code shared by every bank) ---

column5: EX1 handler: cmd byte from FF24, data bytes from FF25 into E28C..
switch on E28B, see research notes for the table
low nibble 1/2: addr hi; 3/6: write data; 5: autoinc; 0: indirect
first byte of the I2C write (sub-address)
byte written by 0x3B; block length for 0xBA/0xBB
byte returned by an I2C read from 0x35
bit1 start/sub received, bit2 data in, bit4 stop

column1: # --- DP TX1 (the DP output port; TX0 is unused by this firmware) ---

column5: timing words BBB7..BBC6, then MISC0/1, then the VSC colorimetry decision
re-evaluates MISC and the VSC colorimetry slot on a format change
MISC0 bpc/format/colorimetry and MISC1 from DF2D/DF2E/DF2F
BC00 bits 5 and 3 from the forwarded HDR/other SDPs
BBB6 bit 6 = 1 (colorimetry carried in the VSC SDP)
DF2F[6:3]; 0x0D gates the VSC colorimetry path
DF25[7:6]; bit 6 also gates the VSC colorimetry path
VSC DB16..18 from DF2D (pixel encoding) and DF2E (extended colorimetry)
type 7: VSC (HB2/HB3 05/13 when colorimetry is 0x0D, else 01/01); type 0x0D: HDR metadata 0x87
payload through BC8B/BC8C, slot select BC8D

column1: # --- DP RX stream 1 (VRR groundwork; roles not yet confirmed) ---

column5: writes DPF_CTRL_0 (B130: only disp_en is ever set) and DP_RSV1 (B191)
disp_en off + dpf_reset, B141-B150 timing and B133-B137 frame-sync offsets from the MSA, then B130 &= 0x4F (full-last-line mode)

column5: B7C0 bit 7 = 0, then dpcd_set_addr_at_dptr at B7C1

default handler, low nibble 1/2: E28D = data

default handler, low nibble 5: E28F = data

column1: # --- DP RX HDR metadata capture (bank 1) and per-port status ---

column5: per port: copy the received HDR metadata SDP into a cache, update the E35D+5*port status
port 1 (the hub's input): bit1 metadata present, bit3 new metadata (acked by hdmi_drm_update)
port 1 HDR metadata cache: DD9D version, DD9E length, DD9F.. payload
PB1: EOTF (0 SDR gamma, 2 PQ, 3 HLG); stays latched (0) after the source leaves HDR
polled: metadata absent -> HDR packet off; new -> rebuild (slot 2A) and re-enable; else keep on
tail of hdmi_drm_update: 5B6B bit5 (pr_spkt3_en) = 1 (BT.2020 patch hook)
tail of hdmi_drm_update: 5B6B bit5 = 0 (BT.2020 patch hook)
R5 selects the builder (0 AVI, 3 HDR/DRM, ...), R7 the packet SRAM address (5B6D); then commits
AVI InfoFrame into the CCFF buffer, then into the once-packet registers 5B44..
HDR (DRM, type 87h) InfoFrame from the port's metadata cache
5B6C bit7 (write packet SRAM), wait for done (bit4); C = 1 on success
5B6B |= 0xFC: every packet slot on, the HDR one included
port index used by the packet builders
staged packet: CCFF version, CD00 length, CD01 checksum, CD02.. payload

column1: # --- HDMI TX deep colour (bank 2): stock bug, 5B07 colour depth survives a 12-bit -> 8-bit switch ---

column5: 8-bit branch of hdmi_set_deep_color (the fix hooks here)
[4:0] colorimetry code from the RX format query (field 8), [6:5] field 7; keeps 0E after HDR -> SDR
D0 after an HDR session, 00 after a fresh start in SDR

column1: # --- DP RX stream 2 (the hub's input) format and colorimetry, bank 5 ---

column5: MISC1 (B403) bit6 set: VSC path (B446.., sets flag 0x2E); else MISC0 (B402) path; fills DE11..DE13
DE12[3:0] = MISC0[4:1]; keeps DE12[7:4], so the VSC colorimetry survives HDR -> SDR
flag 0x2E (VSC) set: encoding from DE11, then rx2_colorimetry_from_vsc
updates DE12[7:4] from CCFE and calls rx2_colorimetry_from_vsc without checking flag 0x2E
YCbCr: E3E6[3:0] = 7 + DE12[7:4] (BT.2020 YCbCr -> 0x0E); RGB: DE12[7:4] table
compares the live MISC0/MISC1 with the cached format
[7:4] VSC colorimetry (stale after HDR -> SDR), [3:0] MISC0[4:1]
[3:0] code 0..14 read by the HDMI side as field 8 (E0E7[4:0]); 0x0E = BT.2020 YCbCr
bank call target of 1480: R7 port, R5 field; dispatches on the input type
port 1: link checks, rx2_capture_format, rx2_apply_format, ..., dprx2_program_dpf_timing
polled via the 17FD trampoline: f6d7, e004, rx2_format_matches_q, ea86, f332; C = 1 when unchanged
stream 2 copy of bank 6 9EDA (the live stream): disp_en off at 931F, full-last-line at 94CC
